name: Intercom
label: Intercom — contacts, companies, conversations
description: Official Intercom REST. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer private-app or OAuth access token. baseUrl is https://{region} (api.intercom.io / api.eu.intercom.io / api.au.intercom.io — https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis). extraHeaders send Intercom-Version: 2.16 (https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/introduction). Legacy /users and /leads collections are retired. trigger.listen is ingress. Customer owns the workspace. Conversations are PII. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation Intercom JSON keys. Create contact needs email or external_id. trigger.listen does not call HTTP. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"contact.get","id":"…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT catalog verb including trigger.listen.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Contact, company, or tag id depending on the operation.

schema.label: contact_id
schema.description: Contact id path for tag.add.

schema.label: role
schema.description: Contact role. EXACT: user | lead. contact.create / contact.update.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email for contact.create / contact.update. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: Your user id. Official external_id. contact.create / contact.update.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Contact or company name. contact.* / company.*.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Contact phone. contact.create / contact.update.

schema.label: custom_attributes
schema.description: Custom attributes map for contact/company create and update.

schema.label: unsubscribed_from_emails
schema.description: Official unsubscribed_from_emails. contact.create / contact.update.

schema.label: company_id
schema.description: Your company id. Official company_id for company.create / company.update.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size for list operations. Example: 20.

schema.label: starting_after
schema.description: Cursor for contact.list / conversation.list.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Page number for company.list.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Intercom from-object escape hatch for conversation.create and message.send. Purpose fields from_type/from_id merge as from.type / from.id via bodyMap. Example: {"type":"user","id":"123"}.

schema.label: body
schema.description: HTML/plain body for conversation.create, conversation.reply, message.send.

schema.label: conversation_id
schema.description: Conversation id path for conversation.reply.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Reply author type for conversation.reply. EXACT: admin | user.

schema.label: admin_id
schema.description: Admin id for conversation.reply when type=admin.

schema.label: message_type
schema.description: conversation.reply message_type (comment|note) or message.send message_type (inapp|email).

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Email subject for message.send when message_type=email.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Intercom to-object escape hatch for message.send. Purpose fields to_type/to_id merge as to.type / to.id via bodyMap. Example: {"type":"user","id":"456"}.

schema.label: from_type
schema.description: Sender type on conversation.create / message.send. Nested as from.type. EXACT common: user | lead | admin | contact. Example: user.

schema.label: from_id
schema.description: Sender id on conversation.create / message.send. Nested as from.id. Example: 123.

schema.label: to_type
schema.description: Recipient type on message.send. Nested as to.type. EXACT common: user | lead | admin | contact. Example: user.

schema.label: to_id
schema.description: Recipient id on message.send. Nested as to.id. Example: 456.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. trigger.listen: BPMN message event (verify X-Hub-Signature on ingress). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Secrets never included.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Intercom private-app or OAuth access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log. Developer Hub.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Workspace API host without scheme. US: api.intercom.io. EU: api.eu.intercom.io. AU: api.au.intercom.io. Substituted into baseUrl https://{region}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Webhooks must be answered in ~5s on ingress.
